about: Post-hoc supplement written after the first reserved test run; not part of the reserved totals. Labels from the unchanged oracle.
label_method: oracle.py over the cited rule rows; hand-specified rows are marked in the case rule field

sources.locator: slide 19, car made in Thailand, FOB 2,250, Philippine part C counted by accumulation

cases.rationale: Post-hoc supplement: reserved case acfta-test-authority-variants-01 errored because its input carried method direct, which ACFTA refuses (its pre-registered parent input does too, D950); same facts without the field. Variation of the published worked example ac-accumulation-with (slide 19, car made in Thailand, FOB 2,250, Philippine part C counted by accumulation): originating material loses status, under row Art. 4(1) (RVC40). The rule row and arithmetic are those of the cited source; the changed facts decide the label.
